item.title: Men detained in Midlands after drugs bust
item.description: Gardaí in the Midlands are at the centre of a major organised crime investigation under Operation Tara. Three men arrested today are being detained at Garda stations in the Midlands and Dublin in connection with alleged drug-related intimidation offences. The nationwide operation began on Monday, with 16 homes and businesses searched. item.title: Castlerea energy plant gets planning - despite claims it could cause a death
item.description: Roscommon County Council has given the go-ahead for an energy-storage plant in Castlerea – despite an objector claiming it could cause a death. Old Mill Energy wants to build it on a 1.5-acre site at Knockmurray. It’d include a battery energy storage-system compound, with battery energy-storage containers. Advertisement The council has granted planning permission, with 21 conditions, despite two objections. One person claimed the plant could overheat, causing a fire, explosion, and fatality.

item.title: Drug-driving Longford pharmacist avoids jail after giving €30,000 to garda he assaulted
item.description: A drug-driving Longford pharmacist has avoided jail and been given a two-year suspended sentence for assaulting a garda after a high-speed chase. The incident happened in Longford town at around midnight on October 4, 2020. 42-year-old Sean Stakelum, of Park Road in Longford, was nearly four times over the drink-driving limit and on cocaine. item.title: Glowing HIQA report for local centre
item.description: A county Mayo centre for people with disabilities, which accomodates those from county Roscommon has received a glowing report from the health watchdog. An unannounced inspection by HIQA has found that Willow Lodge Respite Care Service is delivering good-quality, person-centred care. Willow Lodge provides a respite service for up-to-three residents with physical and learning disabilities. item.title: Dáil hears of Lough Funshinagh flooding
item.description: The Dáil has heard of the impact of flooding at Lough Funshinagh in county Roscommon. Roscommon- East Galway TD Michael Fitzmaurice was speaking on statements on flooding. A meeting at Leinster House last month saw locally elected members agree to raise the ongoing flooding in the area on the floors of both the Dáil and Seanad.
